check.arg: p='/var/lib/mysql/resbench_demo' want='000' got=$(stat -c '%a' "$p" 2>&1) if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then case "$got" in *ermission?denied*) echo "self-check cannot read $p (permission denied)" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac got=absent fi origin=$(awk -F: -v k="$p" '$1 == k { print $2 }' /tmp/chaos-file-chmod.tmp 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) # 按八进制数值比，不按字符串比：stat -c '%a' 对 000 只输出 "0"，而 chaosblade 的 # --mark 必须写成 "000"（写 "0" 会报 illegal mark）；chaosblade 自己记的原始权限 # 也可能是 "0"/"00"。统一去掉前导 0（"000"→"0"，"0755"→"755"）再比。 norm_mode() { v=$1 while [ "${v#0}" != "$v" ]; do v=${v#0}; done [ -n "$v" ] || v=0 printf '%s' "$v" } got_n=$(norm_mode "$got") want_n=$(norm_mode "$want") origin_n=$(norm_mode "$origin") mode_ok=false; [ "$got_n" = "$want_n" ] && mode_ok=true not_noop=true if [ -n "$origin" ] && [ "$origin_n" = "$want_n" ]; then not_noop=false; fi enforced=false if [ "$mode_ok" = true ] && [ "$not_noop" = true ]; then enforced=true; fi if [ "$enforced" = true ]; then summary='权限已改成下发值' elif [ "$not_noop" = false ]; then summary='注入前权限本来就是该值，chmod 空转' else summary='权限仍是原值，chmod 没有生效' fi printf '{"enforced": %s, "summary": "%s", "checks": [{"name": "mode_equals_mark", "observed": "%s", "expected": "%s", "matched": %s}, {"name": "not_a_noop", "observed": "origin=%s", "expected": "origin differs from mark", "matched": %s}]}\n' \ "$enforced" "$summary" "$got" "$want" "$mode_ok" "${origin:-unknown}" "$not_noop"
